value.signature: fn computed_proposal_commitment (body : & ProposalBody , pair : & ContentPair , dependency_nonce : & SecretSlice < u8 > , list : & SecretBox < DependencyIds > ,) -> Result < ComputedProposalCommitment , ProfileError >

review.body: { if body . structural . content == ContentRequest :: FullEmpty && payload_length (& pair . payload) ? != 0 { return Err (ProfileError :: Representation) ; } let content = content_pre_digest (& body . structural . id , pair) ? ; proposal_commitment (body , & content , dependency_nonce , list) . map (ComputedProposalCommitment) }
review.item_premise: The public body, identity and final commitments are recorded completely. Content pairs, both nonces, salts, dependency lists and pre-digests stay in secrecy carriers with redacted Debug; only the admitted final residues, representation refusals and explicit carriage-equality result leave their inventoried boundaries. No entropy, freshness or authority is inferred.
